answer: The protocol raises the barrier each epoch, so the rising tide of fake identities costs attackers linearly more capital and energy than honest participants spend, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-work tied to scarce physical resources: each agent must burn a verifiable ember of compute plus stake nectar tokens locked against its identity. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
